eyebrow: Why order_date came back as string
code:
CSV carries no type information.
The classifier samples values and guesses.
It under-commits on purpose:
string is safer than guessing wrong.
caption: A reasonable default, not a bug — but worth knowing how to fix.

code:
SELECT date_parse(order_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
  AS order_date_parsed
FROM northfield_raw_db.orders_raw
LIMIT 5;
caption: No schema change needed — right fit for a one-off ad hoc question.
